description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier for displaying an alert dialog related to a deep link prompt involving an 'OpenClaw' agent. It manages user interactions (accept or cancel) for running an agent based on a prompt stored in the environment model.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPromptAlert
classes.description: A ViewModifier that presents an alert for a deep link agent prompt, allowing the user to accept or decline.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds the view hierarchy that conditionally shows an alert based on the prompt binding.

methods.name: promptBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding to the optional deep link prompt, with a custom setter that does not update the state.
